verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a built-in AI assistant that answers based on your notes, accepts blocks or notes as context in AI Chats, and can plan multi-step work and propose creates/updates for you to approve. It also suggests tags drawn from your existing tags and summarizes selected content, which together deliver in-product insights and suggestions from your data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality, and evidence of proactive, space-wide insights surfaced without the user prompting.
